name: WOODStreamBot
description: A Telegram Bot to Convert Telegram Files To Direct & Streamable Links.

ENV.description: Set this to True if you don't want to crash the bot

FLOG_CHANNEL.description: ID of Channel Where store files sent by users. Read the readme for more info about this var

ULOG_CHANNEL.description: ID of Channel Where store New Users data. Read the readme for more info about this var

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram User ID as Owner

DATABASE_URL.description: MongoDB URI for saving User Data and Files List created by user.

AUTH_USERS.description: Put IDs of Auth Usrs where bot will work. You can add multiple IDs & separate with Space.

UPDATES_CHANNEL.description: Channel Username without `@` to set channel as Update Channel

FORCE_SUB_ID.description: Channel ID starts with -100 to set channel as Force Sub Channel

FORCE_UPDATES_CHANNEL.description: Set to True, so every user have to Join update channel to use the bot.

FORCE_SUB_LINK.description: Force Sub Channel Link, if you want to use Force Sub.

PORT.description: The port that you want your webapp to be listened to

FQDN.description: Heroku app Link without http/s://, you can set later. its required

FILE_PIC.description: To set Image at /files command. Defaults to pre-set image.

START_PIC.description: To set Image at /start command. Defaults to pre-set image.

VERIFY_PIC.description: To set Image at Force Subscribe Verify. Defaults to pre-set image.

MAX_PLAYLIST_ITEMS.description: Max files bundled into one playlist when you send an album (merged in from telestream-bot). Defaults to 50.

CLEANUP_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between sweeps that delete expired TTL links/playlists (merged in from telestream-bot). Defaults to 600.

ENABLE_SUBTITLES.description: Enable in-browser subtitle extraction in the enhanced player. Needs ffmpeg on the server (merged in from telestream-bot). Defaults to true.

ENABLE_TRACK_PROBE.description: Enable audio/subtitle track listing in the enhanced player. Needs ffprobe on the server (merged in from telestream-bot). Defaults to true.
